articles.summary: Ekho has launched a free Dealer Website Grader to help dealerships understand how visible they are in AI search. With over 30% of buyers already using tools like ChatGPT to research where to buy, the grader evaluates AI visibility, SEO performance, technical site health, and local competitor rankings—giving dealers a clear score and actionable steps to improve their presence in AI-driven discovery.
articles.title: Announcing the Dealer Website Grader
